faqs.text: Shipping: standard delivery takes 3 to 5 working days and costs $6. Orders of $50 or more ship free. Express delivery takes 1 to 2 working days and costs $15.
We currently ship within Pakistan, the UAE and the UK. International orders take 7 to 10 working days.

Returns: items can be returned within 30 days of delivery if unused and in the original packaging. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 to 7 working days after we receive the item. Return shipping is paid by the customer unless the item arrived damaged.
Damaged or faulty items: customers can send a photo to this chat within 7 days of delivery. We replace the item or refund it, and we pay the return shipping.
Warranty: electric grinders and kettles have a 2 year warranty. Manual brewers and accessories have a 6 month warranty. The warranty covers manufacturing faults, not accidental damage.
Payment: we accept credit and debit cards, bank transfer and cash on delivery (Pakistan only, orders up to $200). We do not offer instalment plans.
Order tracking: customers can ask for their order status here by sending the order number, which looks like ORD-1001.
Support hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 to 18:00 Pakistan time. Closed on Sundays. The assistant is available 24 hours, and a teammate replies to handed-over chats during support hours.
Discounts: new customers get 10% off their first order with the code WELCOME10. There are no other active promotions. The assistant cannot create or approve special discounts.
